articles.title: CoreWeave credit default swaps hit distress levels as investors sour on AI debt
articles.summary: It's now facing a rebellion from stock and bond investors as concerns mount about AI overspending and debt levels. articles.title: International Energy Agency to release more than 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible
articles.summary: International Energy Agency members have agreed to release more than 20 million barrels of diesel "as soon as possible" as fuel prices surge globally, the group said in a statement Thursday. articles.title: Treasury yields slide as investors flee to safety of bonds amid tech rout
articles.summary: Treasury yields dropped Thursday, as investors continued to cash in technology shares and fled to the safety of bonds following the latest wholesale inflation data. The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield recently tumbled more than 9 basis points to 5.093%, as did the 30-year Treasury bond yield, to 5.425%.
